1.translation: Fusion is the composition layer. This example places a Chord overview, a Collinear view, a Radial view and a local two-sequence detail into explicit panel rectangles. All links refer to observed HSPs and registered source intervals; repeated displays do not become additional observations.

10.translation: Registered genomic views, nested compositions and registered Cartesian character details are supported according to their contracts. Dotplot, facets and unregistered external plots are not inferred or adapted automatically.
